title: Polynomial-Time Recorder Layout
statement: For every finite-state Boolean Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $C,e,c,A,d$, the function sending a Boolean word $x$ to the packed encoding of the recorder layout formed from the arithmetic preparation header with these parameters is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Boolean Turing machine M
Natural numbers C, e, c, A, and d
replaced: For every source machine and parameters $C, e, c, A, d$, the function sending an instance to the packed encoding of the recorder layout of its arithmetic header is polynomial-time computable.
